name: Method, three cases, and what it was worth
useWhen: A repeatable process produced three concrete examples with a measurable outcome, and the point is that the cases came from the process.

focal.note: Height against headline size. The images carry the evidence; the rail and the band are navy and orange text and never compete with them.

replacesNote: cards-v3 is the middle third of this only. The rail is what turns three nice case studies into an argument that they came out of a process rather than luck.

deviations.source: grey, which is not in the closed palette
deviations.why: Reproducing an off-palette fill for fidelity's sake would reproduce a mistake.

deviations.what: headline printing through its own subtitle
